coverage.shell: acceptance, production delivery and Local Agent scripts
coverage.performance: bounded health and authenticated deployment-status concurrency smoke

issuesFoundAndFixed: The frontend regression now enforces Node.js 20 or newer instead of silently using an incompatible system Node.js 14.
Three intentionally isolated development Builder nodes are recovered only through authenticated admin API and Core RPC precondition checks; the script does not update the database directly.
The secretbox tamper test now flips a decoded ciphertext byte, avoiding non-canonical Base64 characters that can decode to unchanged bytes.
limitations: V3 Android device runtime acceptance was not executed because no explicitly authorized device was attached.
Customer capacity, peak-load, APK throughput and long-duration stability tests are not part of this base regression.
Control-plane-to-Agent Artifact E2E, real AWS, customer SIEM and formal release pipeline evidence remain separate V7 gates.
